docs.title: Curriculum Repository
docs.text:
Educational content management, learning analytics, and documentation tooling.

See the repository README for setup, and the module guides for service contracts and examples.

The documentation workflow validates AST documentation generation without an LLM before building this site.

docs.title: Repo type
docs.text: Educational content management platform (Python web application: content management, user management, multi-format rendering, analytics).

docs.title: Evidence checked
docs.text:
• README.md (platform overview, feature list)
  • docs/ (generated LLM analysis documentation; no manuscript content)
  • Top-level tree: src/, docs/, docker-compose.yml, Dockerfile, Makefile, monitoring configs — application infrastructure only

docs.title: Why no publication-target manuscript applies today
docs.text: Software platform repository with engineering documentation; no analysis outputs, figures, or research claims are produced or tracked here.

docs.title: What would trigger creating one
docs.text: An evaluation study of the platform (e.g. usage analytics or learning effectiveness) with committed analysis outputs and a findings writeup.
